NAVs are calculated under AIC methodology and the debt fair value reflects the estimated fair value of the Company's senior secured notes using a discount rate based on relevant UK gilt redemption yields plus credit spreads derived from month‑end differences between ICE BofAML non-gilt and gilt indices; the discount rate is updated monthly and applied daily, with private placement market divergence considered when spreads materially differ.
